name: FFS_ASSIGNMENT_LOG
description: Stores modification history of activity assignment method fields. This information is required to perform a rollback of a routing run.

columns.name: LOG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the log record.

columns.name: AUTO_ROUTED_TO_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource the activity was assigned to during the latest run of scheduler..

columns.name: AUTO_ROUTED_TO_DATE
columns.description: The date this activity was scheduled for during the latest Routing run.

columns.name: FIRST_MANUAL_OPER
columns.description: The name of the first manual reschedule/move/reorder operation performed after an automatic one.

columns.name: FIRST_MANUAL_OPER_USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user who performed the first manual reschedule/move/reorder operation after an automatic one.

columns.name: FIRST_MANUAL_OPER_INTERFACE
columns.description: The interface the first manual reschedule/move/reorder operation was performed from after an automatic one.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
